description: `float` stores the nearest base-2 fraction, so `0.1 + 0.2 != 0.3` and `2.675` is stored slightly below itself.
Base-10 digits with a context (28 significant digits, `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` by default); build it from strings, never from floats.
Rounds a `Decimal` to a fixed exponent with an explicit mode, such as `Decimal("0.01")` and `ROUND_HALF_UP` for cents.
`round()` sends ties to the even neighbor: `round(2.5) == 2`, `round(3.5) == 4`.
`//` rounds toward negative infinity and `%` takes the sign of the divisor: `-7 // 2 == -4`, `-7 % 2 == 1`.
`int(text)` and `str(number)` raise `ValueError` above 4,300 decimal digits to prevent quadratic-time denial of service.
